name: Sheet
description: An overlay from an edge that the hand swipes away, or to the stops it is given. Opened by its trigger, and only by it, as a Drawer is; drawn by the drawer's numbers.

placement.description: The edge it comes from; start and end follow the page's direction.

snapPoints.description: Where it stops on the way, each a share of its height, such as '33%'; it opens at the first, and all of it is always the last.

isDetached.description: Floats 8 from the edge, round all round.

isDismissable.description: Swiping it away or pressing outside closes it.

footer.description: The actions. A Cancel button's onPress is {do: close}.

closeButton.description: The close button in the corner.

handle.description: The handle on the edge it is dragged by.
